definitions.explanation: Extra space, time, or resources beyond what is strictly necessary.
A calm, relaxed state of mind; not being rushed or stressed.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}に{余裕|よゆう}がない。
examples.english: I don't have any time to spare.

examples.japanese: {余裕|よゆう}を{持|も}って{行動|こうどう}しよう。
examples.notes: 余裕を持つ = to have a margin, to be relaxed

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{余裕|よゆう}のある{態度|たいど}だった。

notes:
USAGE: {余裕|よゆう} refers to having enough of something (time, money, space) or being in a composed mental state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{余裕|よゆう}がある (to have margin/room)
・{余裕|よゆう}がない (to have no margin/room)
・{余裕|よゆう}を{持|も}つ (to allow margin)
・{時間|じかん}の{余裕|よゆう} (spare time)
・{金銭的|きんせんてき}{余裕|よゆう} (financial margin)
・{心|こころ}の{余裕|よゆう} (peace of mind)
